verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an agent framework with a CLI, a web UI and deployable servers could reasonably publish a downloadable OpenAPI spec. The pack shows no such spec. The only OpenAPI mention (google-adk-gh-16) covers ADK consuming OpenAPI specs as agent tools, which is an adjacent feature, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returning 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
